title: REAR WINDOW DEFOGGING EQUIP.-MOTOR, HOSE & DUCT ASM.
summary: Coupe (19437) rear window defogger (RPO C50), LH only: the blower motor mounts on the LH side bulkhead behind the seat, pushes air through a hose to a duct and outlet grille in the rear quarter trim panel. The blower and inlet screen screw to a bracket that is screwed to the bulkhead, with a shield over the motor through a 4.18 in. hole; the grille screws into clip nuts on the duct. A matching hole is cut in the carpet and quarter trim panel.

parts.name: GRILLE
parts.name_expanded: Grille – defogger outlet grille in rear quarter trim panel

fastening.note: Screws [8] go through the screen [10] and bracket [11] into the blower [12].
Screw [9] goes through the bulkhead and bracket [11]; nut assembly [2] on the other side. Three 17/32 dia. holes in the panel (View A).
Shield [1] covers the blower motor where it passes through the 4.18 dia. hole in the side bulkhead; its retention is not clear.
Hose [3] connects the blower outlet to the duct [7]; no clamps shown.
Screws [4] go through the grille [5] (through the opening in the rear quarter trim panel) into nuts [6] clipped on the duct [7] flange.

notes: NOTE Opening required in rear quarter trim panel for grille.

View A (defogging blower motor cut out): 17/32 +0 -1/64 DIA. (3 HOLES IN PANEL); 4.18 DIA IN SIDE BULKHEAD FOR BLOWER MOTOR SHIELD CLEARANCE; dims 6.33, 4.45, .75, .063, 5.13, 3.38, 2.23, 5.16 from rear bulkhead / break line on side bulkhead.
